slideshow.title: Your new favorite onesie, your new favorite memory
slideshow.text: Built for laughs, movie nights, and cozy moments you’ll keep talking about.

testimonials.name: Paige staterman
testimonials.title: NO REGRETS
testimonials.text: Way warmer than I expected and ridiculously soft. I’ve basically been living in it every night. My boyfriend keeps laughing every time I pull the hood over my face, but now he wants one too 😂🐉

testimonials.name: Mike B
testimonials.title: the best gift
testimonials.text: I got this for my daughter because she’s a huge How to Train Your Dragon fan, and it ended up being the perfect gift. The second she saw it, she lit up. It’s unbelievably soft, super warm, and she didn’t want to take it off all night. She ran around the house pretending to be a dragon and had us all laughing. Honestly one of those gifts that’s both cozy and memorable.

testimonials.name: Alyssa and Jordan
testimonials.title: Best use of adult money LOL
testimonials.text: My partner and I both got one, and now they’re officially our movie night uniform 😂 They’re insanely soft, really warm, and oversized in the best way. We threw them on for a stay-in night and ended up laughing the whole time, taking pictures, and fully committing to the cozy dragon look. Such a fun purchase, and somehow still one of the most comfortable things we own.

faqSubtitle: Trouvez rapidement des réponses aux questions les plus courantes sur notre produit.

faq.a: Oui. La polaire est respirante et la coupe ample : parfait pour dormir, traîner à la maison ou pour une soirée film. La capuche se rabat sans gêner et le tissu reste doux lavage après lavage.

faq.q: Est-ce que la taille convient aux adultes ?
faq.a: Oui, le Dragon Onesie™ est un modèle adulte unisexe du S au XL. La coupe est oversize mais le tissu ne s'étire pas : nous recommandons de prendre deux tailles au-dessus de votre taille habituelle (voir le guide des tailles).
Oui. Polaire épaisse double face, coutures renforcées, fermeture à glissière métal. Il se lave en machine à 30 °C et ne bouloche pas.

faq.q: Est-il adapté aux soirées et au cosplay ?
faq.a: Complètement. Soirées pyjama, Halloween, conventions, cosplay ou simple soirée canapé : la capuche aux yeux brodés et aux cornes en relief fait son effet partout.
